scripts.preinstall: node -e "const { unlinkSync } = require('node:fs'); const userAgent = process.env.npm_config_user_agent || ''; if (!userAgent.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); } for (const file of ['package-lock.json', 'yarn.lock']) { try { unlinkSync(file); } catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; } }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
